parts.name: Translation Panel 1
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the sliding panels of the window, composed of a glass pane held within an aluminum frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the window to open or close by sliding horizontally along the track, providing ventilation and access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along the horizontal axis within the window frame.

parts.name: Translation Panel 2
parts.Basic_description: This is the second sliding panel of the window, similar in structure to the first, made of glass and aluminum.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the first panel to open or close the window, allowing flexible control of airflow and light.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in the opposite or same direction as the first panel within the frame track.

parts.name: Base Body (Window Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the window, made of aluminum, providing support and housing for the sliding panels.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the sliding panels in place, ensuring smooth movement and structural integrity of the window assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed boundary for the sliding panels.
